name: Onna no Ko Hajimemashita.
source:
Hayase Katsuki wakes up after a dream about having sex with a woman, only to discover that the girl from his dream is standing right there. To his shock, he realizes that he has transformed into a girl and merged with Shelly, a succubus. Now, Katsuki-chan must gather energy from men to replenish Shelly's magical power as her vessel.

[Translated from [url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ110585.html]DLsite[/url]]
translation:
早濑夏月做了一个与女人发生性关系的梦，醒来后却发现梦中的女孩就站在面前。令他震惊的是，他已经变成女孩，并与魅魔雪莉融为一体。如今，夏月作为雪莉的容器，必须从男人身上汲取能量，为她补充魔力。
